project.name: Loom 多 Agent 编程工作台
project.designRead: developer tool / power users who run multiple AI coding agents / calm technical authority / high density / avoid generic AI-gradient hero and toy-like pastels
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Dark-first technical workbench, Linear/Claude Desktop vibe. Cool neutral surfaces, single sky-blue accent, monospace log/code emphasis, agent color coding. Restrained, professional, developer-native.

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Dark neutral surfaces #181818→#2D2D2D, single accent #97C9F8 sky-blue, semantic green/amber/red, agent identity colors codex #10A37F / claude #D97757 / hermes #7C5CFC
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Cards 10px radius, controls 8px, chips 6px. Hard technical edges, no soft blobs.
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter for UI text (14px body / 12.5px sm / 11px label), Geist Mono / SF Mono for all terminal/log/code/diff (13px). Title 15-16px.
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: Compact developer density: 8/12/16/20px rhythm, tight list rows, dense toolbars.
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: Status dots, agent avatars (colored square with 2-letter initial), monospace terminal cards with line numbers, Linear-style task rows with ID + priority + agent badge, mini-stepper breadcrumbs.
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Border-led depth first. Surfaces layer by background value (#181818 base → #222 card → #2D2D2D elevated → #303030 inset/terminal). Shadows only for floating layers (modal/popover).
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: No photography. Lucide-style line icons only. Visual interest comes from data density, terminal output, diff highlighting, and agent activity — not decorative imagery.
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: Precise and quiet. Hover states lift background to --hover. Active items get --selected. No bounce, no glow, no gradient sweeps.

sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-led static surfaces; floating layers may use shadow
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: primary = accent fill with dark ink; ghost = transparent with border; no gradient buttons
sharedProjectShellContract.navTreatment: Left sidebar #272727 with project tree + task list; top header #181818 with breadcrumb + mini-stepper

sharedRegions: header with sidebar-toggle + breadcrumb + mini-stepper + header-actions-slot
global background, font stack, radius scale, border model

privateRegions: planning chat stream + agent discussion + right summary panel + composer input
task board with status groups + Linear-style task rows
agent session view with thinking/tool-calls/diff + steer input
multi-terminal debug view + debug agent fix-loop + manual feedback
delivery summary with completed items + changed files + verification + timeline

pages.title: 规划讨论室
pages.visualNorthStar: A Codex-app-style planning chat room where multiple agents discuss a requirement in a single stream, with @mention to invoke specific agents, a right panel summarizing consensus/conflicts/risks, and a prominent composer at the bottom.

pages.title: 任务看板
pages.visualNorthStar: A Linear-style task board grouped by status (In Progress / Todo / Testing / Blocked / Done), each row showing status dot + task ID + priority bars + title + tags + Run button + agent badge.

pages.title: 执行中
pages.visualNorthStar: A Claude-Code/Codex-style agent session view: visible agent loop (thinking → Read/Edit/Run tool calls → diff output), with a steer/interrupt input at the bottom and file-change sidebar.

pages.title: 调试验收
pages.visualNorthStar: A multi-terminal debugging cockpit: Frontend + Backend terminals streaming live logs side by side, a Debug agent panel observing logs and proposing fix diffs in a test-cycle loop, and a manual feedback input area.

pages.title: 交付总结
pages.visualNorthStar: A clean delivery summary: completed requirements checklist, changed-files diff stat, verification evidence (test pass/fail counts), key decisions, remaining risks, and a timeline of the task lifecycle.

wiringPlan: page-planning-room → page-task-board (cta-create-tasks, Create tasks from plan)
page-task-board → page-in-progress (cta-run-task, Run a ready task)
page-in-progress → page-testing-cockpit (cta-mark-testing, Mark ready for testing)
hiddenInteractionPlan: page-delivery-summary → page-planning-room (cta-followup, hideEdge=true, Start follow-up returns to planning)
